name: frc256
description: Temporal dither (FRC) for a sixteen-level panel. Every pixel blinks between two adjacent hardware levels, the duty on a sixteen-frame cycle carrying the fraction, so a fast display shows about 256 shades on four bits. The source is resampled through a Catmull-Rom kernel, so a pass rendered at four times the output size downscales sharp instead of boxy. Wants the panel's full frame rate, about 200 fps on the SSD1322.
